dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello! Please line up here for tickets.
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ! ˈpliːz ˈlaɪn ˈʌp ˈhɪr fər ˈtɪkɪts.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, do you need a ticket, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈniːd ə ˈtɪkɪt, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. It's free for Thai people.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ɪts ˈfriː fər ˈtaɪ ˈpiːpəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please take off your shoes and wait here.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ˈpliːz ˈteɪk ˈɔːf jʊr ˈʃuːz ənd ˈweɪt ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can I use this restroom?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən aɪ ˈjuːz ðɪs ˈrɛstruːm?
